source_units.text: A geography lesson includes photographs of moving ice.
Build a study timetable for glacier dynamics.
The syllabus consists of "Glacier Mass Balance", "Crevasse Formation", "Basal Sliding"; each named topic needs a minimum of 25 minutes in total.
My study window closes on 2027-02-04; that date is still available.
I would prefer to encounter "Basal Sliding" early; treat that as a suggestion only, not a time requirement.
The total of all sessions on any one date must not exceed 35 minutes.
